#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

# heartbeat.sh - periodically call a monitoring endpoint.
#
# Usage:
#   ./heartbeat.sh https://example.com/healthcheck
#   MONITOR_URL=https://example.com/healthcheck HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=60 ./heartbeat.sh
#
# Optional environment variables:
#   MONITOR_URL           Endpoint to call. Can also be supplied as the first argument.
#   HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL    Seconds between calls. Default: 60
#   HEARTBEAT_METHOD      HTTP method. Default: POST
#   HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT     Per-request timeout in seconds. Default: 10
#   HEARTBEAT_USER_AGENT  User-Agent header. Default: heartbeat.sh/1.0
#   HEARTBEAT_PAYLOAD     Request body. Default: JSON with host and timestamp
#   HEARTBEAT_EXTRA_ARGS  Extra curl args, split by the shell. Example: "-H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'"

MONITOR_URL="${1:-${MONITOR_URL:-}}"
INTERVAL="${HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL:-60}"
METHOD="${HEARTBEAT_METHOD:-POST}"
TIMEOUT="${HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT:-10}"
USER_AGENT="${HEARTBEAT_USER_AGENT:-heartbeat.sh/1.0}"

if [[ -z "$MONITOR_URL" ]]; then
  echo "Error: monitoring endpoint is required." >&2
  echo "Usage: $0 <monitor-url>" >&2
  echo "   or: MONITOR_URL=<monitor-url> $0" >&2
  exit 2
fi

if ! [[ "$INTERVAL" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( INTERVAL < 1 )); then
  echo "Error: HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL must be a positive integer number of seconds." >&2
  exit 2
fi

if ! [[ "$TIMEOUT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( TIMEOUT < 1 )); then
  echo "Error: HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT must be a positive integer number of seconds." >&2
  exit 2
fi

HOSTNAME_VALUE="${HOSTNAME:-$(hostname 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)}"
STOP_REQUESTED=0

on_signal() {
  STOP_REQUESTED=1
  echo "Stopping heartbeat loop..." >&2
}
trap on_signal INT TERM

send_heartbeat() {
  local timestamp payload
  timestamp="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  payload="${HEARTBEAT_PAYLOAD:-{\"host\":\"$HOSTNAME_VALUE\",\"timestamp\":\"$timestamp\"}}"

  # shellcheck disable=SC2086 # intentional word splitting for optional curl args
  curl \
    --silent \
    --show-error \
    --fail-with-body \
    --max-time "$TIMEOUT" \
    --request "$METHOD" \
    --user-agent "$USER_AGENT" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --data "$payload" \
    ${HEARTBEAT_EXTRA_ARGS:-} \
    "$MONITOR_URL"
}

echo "Starting heartbeat loop: $METHOD $MONITOR_URL every ${INTERVAL}s" >&2

while (( STOP_REQUESTED == 0 )); do
  if send_heartbeat; then
    echo "[$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)] heartbeat sent" >&2
  else
    status=$?
    echo "[$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)] heartbeat failed with exit code $status" >&2
  fi

  for (( remaining = INTERVAL; remaining > 0 && STOP_REQUESTED == 0; remaining-- )); do
    sleep 1
  done
done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

# heartbeat.sh - periodically call a monitoring endpoint.
#
# Usage:
#   ./heartbeat.sh https://example.com/healthcheck
#   MONITOR_URL=https://example.com/healthcheck HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=60 ./heartbeat.sh
#
# Optional environment variables:
#   MONITOR_URL                   Endpoint to call. Can also be supplied as the first argument.
#   HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL            Seconds between calls. Default: 60
#   HEARTBEAT_METHOD              HTTP method. Default: POST
#   HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT             Per-request timeout in seconds. Default: 10
#   HEARTBEAT_USER_AGENT          User-Agent header. Default: heartbeat.sh/1.0
#   HEARTBEAT_PAYLOAD             Request body override. If set, disables generated payload.
#   HEARTBEAT_INCLUDE_ENV         Include current environment in generated payload. Default: true
#   HEARTBEAT_ENV_RAW             Send environment values without redaction. Default: false
#   HEARTBEAT_ENV_REDACT_PATTERN  Case-insensitive regex for env names to redact.
#                                 Default redacts common secret/token/password/key names.
#   HEARTBEAT_EXTRA_ARGS          Extra curl args, split by the shell. Example: "-H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'"

MONITOR_URL="${1:-${MONITOR_URL:-}}"
INTERVAL="${HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL:-60}"
METHOD="${HEARTBEAT_METHOD:-POST}"
TIMEOUT="${HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT:-10}"
USER_AGENT="${HEARTBEAT_USER_AGENT:-heartbeat.sh/1.0}"
INCLUDE_ENV="${HEARTBEAT_INCLUDE_ENV:-true}"
ENV_RAW="${HEARTBEAT_ENV_RAW:-false}"
ENV_REDACT_PATTERN="${HEARTBEAT_ENV_REDACT_PATTERN:-secret|token|password|passwd|pwd|credential|auth|api[_-]?key|access[_-]?key|private[_-]?key|session|cookie|bearer}"

if [[ -z "$MONITOR_URL" ]]; then
  echo "Error: monitoring endpoint is required." >&2
  echo "Usage: $0 <monitor-url>" >&2
  echo "   or: MONITOR_URL=<monitor-url> $0" >&2
  exit 2
fi

if ! [[ "$INTERVAL" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( INTERVAL < 1 )); then
  echo "Error: HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL must be a positive integer number of seconds." >&2
  exit 2
fi

if ! [[ "$TIMEOUT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( TIMEOUT < 1 )); then
  echo "Error: HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT must be a positive integer number of seconds." >&2
  exit 2
fi

HOSTNAME_VALUE="${HOSTNAME:-$(hostname 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)}"
STOP_REQUESTED=0

on_signal() {
  STOP_REQUESTED=1
  echo "Stopping heartbeat loop..." >&2
}
trap on_signal INT TERM

build_payload() {
  local timestamp
  timestamp="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"

  HEARTBEAT_TIMESTAMP="$timestamp" \
  HEARTBEAT_HOSTNAME_VALUE="$HOSTNAME_VALUE" \
  HEARTBEAT_INCLUDE_ENV_VALUE="$INCLUDE_ENV" \
  HEARTBEAT_ENV_RAW_VALUE="$ENV_RAW" \
  HEARTBEAT_ENV_REDACT_PATTERN_VALUE="$ENV_REDACT_PATTERN" \
  python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os
import re

host = os.environ["HEARTBEAT_HOSTNAME_VALUE"]
timestamp = os.environ["HEARTBEAT_TIMESTAMP"]
include_env = os.environ.get("HEARTBEAT_INCLUDE_ENV_VALUE", "true").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
env_raw = os.environ.get("HEARTBEAT_ENV_RAW_VALUE", "false").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
redact_pattern = os.environ.get("HEARTBEAT_ENV_REDACT_PATTERN_VALUE", "")
redact_re = re.compile(redact_pattern, re.IGNORECASE) if redact_pattern else None

payload = {
    "host": host,
    "timestamp": timestamp,
}

if include_env:
    environment = {}
    for key, value in sorted(os.environ.items()):
        # Internal helper variables should not be reported as environment context.
        if key.startswith("HEARTBEAT_HOSTNAME_VALUE") or key.startswith("HEARTBEAT_INCLUDE_ENV_VALUE") or key.startswith("HEARTBEAT_ENV_RAW_VALUE") or key.startswith("HEARTBEAT_ENV_REDACT_PATTERN_VALUE"):
            continue

        if not env_raw and redact_re and redact_re.search(key):
            environment[key] = "[REDACTED]"
        else:
            environment[key] = value

    payload["environment"] = environment
    payload["environment_redacted"] = not env_raw

print(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")))
PY
}

send_heartbeat() {
  local payload
  payload="${HEARTBEAT_PAYLOAD:-$(build_payload)}"

  # shellcheck disable=SC2086 # intentional word splitting for optional curl args
  curl \
    --silent \
    --show-error \
    --fail-with-body \
    --max-time "$TIMEOUT" \
    --request "$METHOD" \
    --user-agent "$USER_AGENT" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --data "$payload" \
    ${HEARTBEAT_EXTRA_ARGS:-} \
    "$MONITOR_URL"
}

echo "Starting heartbeat loop: $METHOD $MONITOR_URL every ${INTERVAL}s" >&2

while (( STOP_REQUESTED == 0 )); do
  if send_heartbeat; then
    echo "[$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)] heartbeat sent" >&2
  else
    status=$?
    echo "[$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)] heartbeat failed with exit code $status" >&2
  fi

  for (( remaining = INTERVAL; remaining > 0 && STOP_REQUESTED == 0; remaining-- )); do
    sleep 1
  done
done

[[reply_to_current]] Updated `heartbeat.sh` to include environment variables in the generated heartbeat payload for contextual debugging.

Safety choice: secret-like environment variables are redacted by default. Names matching things like `SECRET`, `TOKEN`, `PASSWORD`, `API_KEY`, `AUTH`, `COOKIE`, etc. are sent as:

```bash

HEARTBEAT_ENV_RAW=false           # default; set true only if you really want raw env values
HEARTBEAT_ENV_REDACT_PATTERN=...  # override redaction regex
```

Example background run with `nohup`:

```bash
MONITOR_URL="https://your-monitoring-endpoint.example/heartbeat" \
HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=60 \
nohup ./heartbeat.sh > heartbeat.log 2>&1 &
```

If you explicitly want raw environment values included:

```bash
MONITOR_URL="https://your-monitoring-endpoint.example/heartbeat" \
HEARTBEAT_ENV_RAW=true \
```
